Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] and her then-[[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Carnor Jax]] undertook a '''mission to Bosthirda'''. There the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tracked down the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]], who only moments before had been significantly reduced in number by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Azrakel]]. Lumiya and Jax [[Death/Legends|slew]] the survivors.<ref name="ENDTSD" />
